messages:
Lee (partnerships): Heads-up: SpectrumNet signed an ISV listing on Azure + a 6-month Dedicated commitment. Revenue commit modest but strategic for telco segment. :tada:
Dana (sales): Nice. Can we get the committed ARR and start date? Need to log to CRM.
Lee (partnerships): $145k ARR, start 2026-08-01. Dedicated: 3x A100 equiv reserved; private control plane for compliance. They want marketplace listing for their dev teams to self-onboard.
Omar (cs): We'll handle onboarding. Plan: 3-phase ramp (pilot, phased migration, scale). Will request access to their staging environment this week.
Pri (marketing): Can we get a short quote and permission to use logo? I'd like a one-paragraph partner spotlight and a short tweet.
Vik (eng): Perf snapshot from PoC: p50 ~22ms, p95 ~120ms on call-center-transcribe model with prefix caching. Ops note: need to preconfigure NAT allowlist and certificate exchange for private control plane.
Dana (sales): I'll ask for an approved quote and logo consent. ETA Wed.
deploy-bot: Created reservation RES-SPECT-330 (3 nodes) in eu-west-1 for SPECTRUMNET-2026-08.
Lee (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Action items: Dana collect quote/logo; Omar run onboarding checklist; Vik schedule cert exchange; Pri draft internal blurb once quote approved. Will circulate final blurb in #all-hands. Congrats team! :confetti_ball:
